This unit is well built, holds the temperature well and evenly distributes the heat.  Though it is brand new, I expect to enjoy it for a long time.  

My recommendations to reach 5 stars would be that there is a bin to hold a few miscellaneous items, casters on all 4 legs (though it would require a locking mechanism that adds cost), and smaller hooks on the sides.  Most of my grill tools do not have holes large enough for the hooks.

Results.ReviewText:
The Spirit ll is all that I expected and needed from a gas grill and is a great addition on my patio along with my charcoal grill & smoker. Webers of course! The Spirit ll offers quick start burners to grill your foods quickly when in a hurry or the flexibility to create tasty meals all day for friends or family. I really like the three burner model as it offers a cool zone to move your food too by turning off one burner but still having the other two for grilling. A real nifty feature I love is the option to reverse the porcelain cast iron grates to control the width of the bars so food won't fall through plus to get different size grill marks on food. Now that's cool ! Everything grilled so far was time well spent........ no disappointments !
I assembled the unit myself and it was a pleasure to see the quality and thought put into building it and am sure it will easily provide many many years of backyard grilling.  Plus with Webers 10 yr warranty it's no wonder why the Spirit ll E-310 was added to my backyard patio !
Results.Title: A repeat Weber griller (smoker too!)

With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
